params.description: The ID of an existing customer within Chargify. Required, unless a `customer_reference` or a set of `customer_attributes` is given.

params.name: subscription-customer-reference
params.description: The reference value (provided by your app) of an existing customer within Chargify. Required, unless a `customer_id` or a set of `customer_attributes` is given.

params.name: subscription-defer-signup
params.description: (Optional) Set this attribute to true to create the subscription in the Awaiting Signup Date state. Use this when you want to create a subscription that has an unknown first billing date. When the first billing date is known, update a subscription and set the `initial_billing_at` date. The subscription moves to the Awaiting Signup state with a scheduled initial billing date. You can omit the initial_billing_at date to activate the subscription immediately. See [Subscription States](https://maxio-chargify.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/5404222005773-Subscription-States) for more information.

params.name: subscription-dunning-communication-delay-enabled
params.description: Enable Communication Delay feature, making sure no communication (email or SMS) is sent to the Customer between 9PM and 8AM in time zone set by the `dunning_communication_delay_time_zone` attribute.

params.name: subscription-dunning-communication-delay-time-zone
params.description: Time zone for the Dunning Communication Delay feature.

params.name: subscription-expiration-tracks-next-billing-change
params.description: (Optional, default false) When set to true, and when next_billing_at is present, if the subscription expires, the expires_at will be shifted by the same amount of time as the difference between the old and new “next billing” dates.

params.name: subscription-expires-at
params.description: Timestamp giving the expiration date of this subscription (if any). You may manually change the expiration date at any point during a subscription period.

params.name: subscription-group-billing
params.description: Billing

params.name: subscription-group-target
params.description: Target

params.name: subscription-import-mrr
params.description: Setting this attribute to true will cause the subscription's MRR to be added to your MRR analytics immediately. For this value to be honored, a next_billing_at must be present and set to a future date. This key/value will not be returned in the subscription response body.

params.name: subscription-initial-billing-at
params.description: (Optional) Set this attribute to a future date/time to create a subscription in the Awaiting Signup state, rather than Active or Trialing. You can omit the initial_billing_at date to activate the subscription immediately. In the Awaiting Signup state, a subscription behaves like any other. It can be canceled, allocated to, or have its billing date changed. etc. When the initial_billing_at date hits, the subscription will transition to the expected state. If the product has a trial, the subscription will enter a trial, otherwise it will go active. Setup fees will be respected either before or after the trial, as configured on the price point. If the payment is due at the initial_billing_at and it fails the subscription will be immediately canceled. See the [subscription import](https://maxio.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/24251489107213-Advanced-Billing-Subscription-Imports#date-format) documentation for more information about Date/Time Formats.

params.name: subscription-metafields
params.description: (Optional) A set of key/value pairs representing custom fields and their values. Metafields will be created “on-the-fly” in your site for a given key, if they have not been created yet.

params.name: subscription-net-terms
params.description: (Optional) Default: null The number of days after renewal (on invoice billing) that a subscription is due. A value between 0 (due immediately) and 180.

params.name: subscription-next-billing-at
params.description: (Optional) Set this attribute to a future date/time to sync imported subscriptions to your existing renewal schedule. See the notes on “Date/Time Format” in our [subscription import documentation](https://maxio.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/24251489107213-Advanced-Billing-Subscription-Imports#date-format). If you provide a next_billing_at timestamp that is in the future, no trial or initial charges will be applied when you create the subscription. In fact, no payment will be captured at all. The first payment will be captured, according to the prices defined by the product, near the time specified by next_billing_at. If you do not provide a value for next_billing_at, any trial and/or initial charges will be assessed and charged at the time of subscription creation. If the card cannot be successfully charged, the subscription will not be created. See further notes in the section on Importing Subscriptions.

params.name: subscription-offer-id
params.description: Use in place of passing product and component information to set up the subscription with an existing offer. May be either the Chargify id of the offer or its handle prefixed with `handle:`.er

params.name: subscription-payment-collection-method
params.description: The type of payment collection to be used in the subscription. For legacy Statements Architecture valid options are - `invoice`, `automatic`. For current Relationship Invoicing Architecture valid options are - `remittance`, `automatic`, `prepaid`.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-billing-address
params.description: (Optional, may be required by your product configuration or gateway settings) The credit card or bank account billing street address (i.e. 123 Main St.). This value is merely passed through to the payment gateway.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-billing-address-2
params.description: (Optional) Second line of the customer’s billing address i.e. Apt. 100

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-billing-city
params.description: (Optional, may be required by your product configuration or gateway settings) The credit card or bank account billing address city (i.e. “Boston”). This value is merely passed through to the payment gateway.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-billing-country
params.description: (Optional, may be required by your product configuration or gateway settings) The credit card or bank account billing address country, required in [ISO_3166-1 alpha-2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) format (i.e. “US”). This value is merely passed through to the payment gateway. Some gateways require country codes in a specific format. Check your gateway’s documentation. If creating an ACH subscription, only US is supported at this time.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-billing-state
params.description: (Optional, may be required by your product configuration or gateway settings) The credit card or bank account billing address state (i.e. MA). This value is merely passed through to the payment gateway. This must conform to the [ISO_3166-1](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1#Current_codes) in order to be valid for tax locale purposes.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-billing-zip
params.description: (Optional, may be required by your product configuration or gateway settings) The credit card or bank account billing address zip code (i.e. 12345). This value is merely passed through to the payment gateway.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-card-type
params.description: The type of card used.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-chargify-token
params.description: (Optional) Token received after sending billing information using Maxio.js (formerly Chargify.js). This token must be passed as a sole attribute of `payment_profile_attributes` (i.e. tok_9g6hw85pnpt6knmskpwp4ttt)

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-current-vault
params.description: The vault that stores the payment profile with the provided `vault_token`. Use `bogus` for testing.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-customer-id
params.description: Customer id

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-customer-vault-token
params.description: (Optional, used only for Subscription Import) (only for Authorize.Net CIM storage or Square) The customerProfileId for the owner of the customerPaymentProfileId provided as the vault_token

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-cvv
params.description: (Optional, may be required by your gateway settings) The 3- or 4-digit Card Verification Value. This value is merely passed through to the payment gateway.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-expiration-month
params.description: (Optional when performing a Subscription Import via vault_token, required otherwise) The 1- or 2-digit credit card expiration month, as an integer or string, i.e. 5

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-expiration-year
params.description: (Optional when performing a Subscription Import via vault_token, required otherwise) The 4-digit credit card expiration year, as an integer or string, i.e. 2012

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-first-name
params.description: (Optional) First name on card or bank account. If omitted, the first_name from customer attributes will be used.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-full-number
params.description: The full credit card number (string representation, i.e. 5424000000000015)

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-gateway-handle
params.description: (Optional) This attribute is only available if MultiGateway feature is enabled for your Site. This feature is in the Private Beta currently. gateway_handle is used to directly select a gateway where a payment profile will be stored in. Every connected gateway must have a unique gateway handle specified. Read [Multigateway description](https://chargify.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4407761759643#connecting-with-multiple-gateways) to learn more about new concepts that MultiGateway introduces and the default behavior when this attribute is not passed.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-id
params.description: Id

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-last-four
params.description: (Optional, used only for Subscription Import) If you have the last 4 digits of the credit card number, you may supply them here so that we may create a masked card number (i.e. XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-1234) for display in the UI. Last 4 digits are required for refunds in Auth.Net.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-last-name
params.description: (Optional) Last name on card or bank account. If omitted, the last_name from customer attributes will be used.

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-masked-card-number
params.description: Masked card number

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-payment-method-nonce
params.description: (Required for Square unless importing with vault_token and customer_vault_token) The nonce generated by the Square Javascript library (SqPaymentForm)

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-payment-type
params.description: Payment type

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-paypal-email
params.description: Paypal email

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-attributes-vault-token
params.description: (Optional, used only for Subscription Import) The “token” provided by your vault storage for an already stored payment profile

params.name: subscription-payment-profile-id
params.description: The Payment Profile ID of an existing card or bank account, which belongs to an existing customer to use for payment for this subscription. If the card, bank account, or customer does not exist already, or if you want to use a new (unstored) card or bank account for the subscription, use `payment_profile_attributes` instead to create a new payment profile along with the subscription. (This value is available on an existing subscription via the API as `credit_card` > id or `bank_account` > id)

params.name: subscription-prepaid-configuration
params.description: JSON object with auto_replenish, initial_funding_amount_in_cents, replenish_threshold_amount_in_cents, replenish_to_amount_in_cents.

params.name: subscription-previous-billing-at
params.description: Providing a previous_billing_at that is in the past will set the current_period_starts_at when the subscription is created. It will also set activated_at if not explicitly passed during the subscription import. Can only be used if next_billing_at is also passed. Using this option will allow you to set the period start for the subscription so mid period component allocations have the correct prorated amount.

params.name: subscription-product-change-delayed
params.description: (Optional) used only for Delayed Product Change When set to true, indicates that a changed value for product_handle should schedule the product change to the next subscription renewal.

params.name: subscription-product-handle
params.description: The API Handle of the product for which you are creating a subscription. Required, unless a `product_id` is given instead.

params.name: subscription-product-id
params.description: The Product ID of the product for which you are creating a subscription. The product ID is not currently published, so we recommend using the API Handle instead.

params.name: subscription-product-price-point-handle
params.description: The user-friendly API handle of a product's particular price point.

params.name: subscription-product-price-point-id
params.description: The ID of the particular price point on the product.

params.name: subscription-reason-code
params.description: (Optional) Can be used when canceling a subscription (via the HTTP DELETE method) to indicate why a subscription was canceled.

params.name: subscription-receives-invoice-emails
params.description: (Optional) Default: True - Whether or not this subscription is set to receive emails related to this subscription.

params.name: subscription-ref
params.description: A valid referral code. (optional, see [Referrals](https://maxio.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/24286981223693-Referrals-Reference#how-to-obtain-referral-codes) for more details). If supplied, must be valid, or else subscription creation will fail.

params.name: subscription-reference
params.description: The reference value (provided by your app) for the subscription itself.

params.name: subscription-sales-rep-id
params.description: Sales rep id

params.name: subscription-skip-billing-manifest-taxes
params.description: Valid only for the Subscription Preview endpoint. When set to `true` it skips calculating taxes for the current and next billing manifests.

params.name: subscription-stored-credential-transaction-id
params.description: For European sites subject to PSD2 and using 3D Secure, this can be used to reference a previous transaction for the customer. This will ensure the card will be charged successfully at renewal.

tools.name: subscriptions-json_list-subscriptions
tools.description: Returns an array of subscriptions from a Site. Pay close attention to query string filters and pagination in order to control responses from the server. ## Search for a subscription Use the query strings below to search for a subscription using the criteria available. The return value will be an array. ## Self-Service Page token Self-Service Page token for the subscriptions is not returned by default. If this information is desired, the include[]=self_service_page_token parameter must be provided with the request. Optional: page (default: 1), per_page (default: 20), state (plus 13 more).

params.name: page
params.description: Result records are organized in pages.

params.name: per_page
params.description: This parameter indicates how many records to fetch in each request.

params.name: state
params.description: The current state of the subscription

params.name: product
params.description: The product id of the subscription. (Note that the product handle cannot be used.)

params.name: product_price_point_id
params.description: The ID of the product price point. If supplied, product is required

params.name: coupon
params.description: The numeric id of the coupon currently applied to the subscription. (This can be found in the URL when editing a coupon. Note that the coupon code cannot be used.)

params.name: coupon_code
params.description: The coupon code currently applied to the subscription

params.name: date_field
params.description: The type of filter you'd like to apply to your search. Allowed Values: , current_period_ends_at, current_period_starts_at, created_at, activated_at, canceled_at, expires_at, trial_started_at, trial_ended_at, updated_at

params.name: start_date
params.description: The start date (format YYYY-MM-DD) with which to filter the date_field. Returns subscriptions with a timestamp at or after midnight (12:00:00 AM) in your site’s time zone on the date specified. Use in query `start_date=2022-07-01`.

params.name: end_date
params.description: The end date (format YYYY-MM-DD) with which to filter the date_field. Returns subscriptions with a timestamp up to and including 11:59:59PM in your site’s time zone on the date specified. Use in query `end_date=2022-08-01`.

params.name: start_datetime
params.description: The start date and time (format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) with which to filter the date_field. Returns subscriptions with a timestamp at or after exact time provided in query. You can specify timezone in query - otherwise your site's time zone will be used. If provided, this parameter will be used instead of start_date. Use in query `start_datetime=2022-07-01 09:00:05`.

params.name: end_datetime
params.description: The end date and time (format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS) with which to filter the date_field. Returns subscriptions with a timestamp at or before exact time provided in query. You can specify timezone in query - otherwise your site's time zone will be used. If provided, this parameter will be used instead of end_date. Use in query `end_datetime=2022-08-01 10:00:05`.

params.name: metadata
params.description: The value of the metadata field specified in the parameter. Use in query `metadata[my-field]=value&metadata[other-field]=another_value`.

params.name: direction
params.description: Controls the order in which results are returned. Use in query `direction=asc`.

params.name: sort
params.description: The attribute by which to sort

params.name: include
params.description: Allows including additional data in the response. Use in query: `include[]=self_service_page_token`.

tools.name: subscriptions-mrr-json_list-mrr-per-subscription
tools.description: This endpoint returns your site's current MRR, including plan and usage breakouts split per subscription. Optional: filter, at_time, page (default: 1) (plus 2 more). Deprecated.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter to use for List MRR per subscription operation

params.name: at_time
params.description: Submit a timestamp in ISO8601 format to request MRR for a historic time. Use in query: `at_time=2022-01-10T10:00:00-05:00`.

params.name: page
params.description: Result records are organized in pages.

params.name: per_page
params.description: This parameter indicates how many records to fetch in each request.

params.name: direction
params.description: Controls the order in which results are returned. Records are ordered by subscription_id in ascending order by default. Use in query `direction=desc`.

tools.name: webhooks_enable
tools.description: Enables webhooks for your site. Required: webhooks_enabled. Returns the updated WebhooksEnableResponse.

params.name: webhooks_enabled
params.description: Webhooks enabled

tools.name: webhooks_replay
tools.description: Replays webhooks. Posting to this endpoint does not immediately resend the webhooks. They are added to a queue and sent as soon as possible, depending on available system resources. You can submit an array of up to 1000 webhook IDs in the replay request. Required: ids. Returns the new WebhooksReplayResponse.

params.name: ids
params.description: Ids

tools.name: webhooks-json_list-webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves a list of webhooks. You can pass query parameters if you want to filter webhooks. See the [Webhooks](page:introduction/webhooks/webhooks) documentation for more information. Optional: status, since_date, until_date (plus 4 more). Returns array of WebhookResponse.

params.name: status
params.description: Webhooks with matching status would be returned.

params.name: since_date
params.description: Format YYYY-MM-DD. Returns Webhooks with the created_at date greater than or equal to the one specified.

params.name: until_date
params.description: Format YYYY-MM-DD. Returns Webhooks with the created_at date less than or equal to the one specified.

params.name: page
params.description: Result records are organized in pages.

params.name: per_page
params.description: This parameter indicates how many records to fetch in each request.

params.name: order
params.description: The order in which the Webhooks are returned.

params.name: subscription
params.description: The Advanced Billing id of a subscription you'd like to filter for

novel_features.name: MRR waterfall
novel_features.description: See MRR move month over month, broken into New, Expansion, Contraction, Churn, and Reactivation — plus ARR and growth rate.

novel_features.name: Per-client recurring revenue
novel_features.description: Normalized MRR for one customer or the whole book, with the history the live API has no endpoint for.

novel_features.name: Retention metrics
novel_features.description: Net and gross revenue retention, logo churn, revenue churn, and quick ratio over any window.

novel_features.name: Cohort retention curves
novel_features.description: Revenue and logo retention by signup-month cohort across N periods.

novel_features.name: Revenue triage
novel_features.description: A ranked list of accounts that need attention: past-due, large upcoming renewals, and high-value concentration.

novel_features.name: Normalized-vs-billed reconcile
novel_features.description: Per-customer gaps between normalized MRR and the amounts actually invoiced, with the deltas flagged.

novel_features.name: Usage expansion drivers
novel_features.description: Which metered/usage components drove expansion versus contraction MRR, ranked.

novel_features.name: Current MRR
novel_features.description: Current MRR + ARR + growth vs the prior snapshot.

novel_features.name: MRR snapshot sync
novel_features.description: Snapshot current MRR and backfill movement history into the local store.

novel_features.name: ARPA and price-vs-volume
novel_features.description: ARPA/ARPU, MRR percentiles, and price-vs-volume decomposition of MRR change.

novel_features.name: Churn breakdown
novel_features.description: Logo and revenue churn per period, voluntary vs involuntary, by reason code.

novel_features.name: Customer concentration
novel_features.description: Customer concentration: share of ARR held by the top 1 / 5 / 10 customers.

novel_features.name: New customers
novel_features.description: New logos acquired per period (first-activation month) plus the new MRR they brought.

novel_features.name: Upcoming renewals
novel_features.description: Active subscriptions renewing within the next N days (default 90), with MRR at risk.

novel_features.name: Revenue mix
novel_features.description: Recurring vs usage vs services split of the latest month's billed line items.
